title: registry.tenant.deactivated payload (v1)
description: Tenant deactivated (terminal): consumers stop accepting work for the tenant; data is retained until the retention purge. Ids and changed field names only; no secrets or password data. Producer: registry. Exchange: aegispulse.domain. FRs: FR-TEN-03, FR-AUD-02. Describes only the envelope `payload` (PROJECT.md §6.4, §6.7); consumers ignore unknown fields (NFR-13).
